# Current record versus proposed package

Current UIST record: publication item `6c5118cb-7261-455c-929d-4ddbd6912728`, “Relationship between FDI Inflow and Unemployment Rate in the Case of the Former Yugoslav Republics,” Handle `123456789/231`, with the attached article PDF and DOI `10.31410/balkans.jetss.2024.7.1.11-20`.

Proposed local record: a separately described, versioned derived aggregate containing one CSV extracted from Table 1. It should link back with `IsDerivedFrom` and preserve the publication as the source record. It must not be represented as the original study data, as an author-issued supplement, or as a comprehensive replication package.

Metadata and rights remain proposed. The package has no assigned identifier, creator/compiler, deposit date, reviewer or accepting authority.
